nonGoals.reason: Deliberate v1 non-goal. PacknPub v1 hardens Node.js + Homebrew end-to-end before adding multi-ecosystem manifest adapters.
nonGoals.revisitCriteria: Requires owner approval and a separate adapter reading PEP 621 pyproject.toml, isolated sdist/wheel verification, and PyPI Trusted Publishers (OIDC) behind a human-approved GitHub Environment.

supportedTargets.authMechanism: GitHub Actions OIDC Trusted Publishing with SLSA provenance (no static NPM_TOKEN)
PR-based bump via fine-grained HOMEBREW_TAP_TOKEN scoped to <owner>/homebrew-tap

checks.description: package.json exists and defines valid name, semver version, files allowlist, repository, and engines.node.
Declared bin entrypoint exists, stays inside repo root, and starts with #!/usr/bin/env node.
Derived artifacts (seed Homebrew formula) match package.json version without drift.
CI workflow, release workflow, and verification script exist.
Every uses: reference in CI and release workflows is pinned to a 40-character commit SHA.
Top-level workflow permissions are read-only or empty; write/id-token scopes are job-scoped only.
Every publish job in release.yml declares environment: release.
Publish jobs verify SHA256SUMS.txt before publishing downloaded artifacts and avoid direct expression injection in run blocks.
Release workflow does not contain the OWNER placeholder.
Tracked PacknPub files match .packnpub/state.json checksums and current contractVersion.
GitHub repository 'release' environment has Required Reviewers configured server-side (cannot be verified offline).
Remote GitHub Actions CI workflow has executed and passed on HEAD.

gateSemantics.passRule: PASS requires every mandatory check in scope to report PASS.
gateSemantics.failRule: FAIL if any mandatory check reports FAIL.
gateSemantics.holdRule: HOLD if zero mandatory checks report FAIL and one or more mandatory checks report UNKNOWN.
gateSemantics.publishAuthorization: A PASS conformance verdict NEVER authorizes registry publication, tagging, or external permission changes.

threatModel.threat: Mutable GitHub Action tag hijacking (@v4 repointed to malicious commit)
threatModel.mitigation: Pin every action to an immutable 40-character commit SHA with a version comment.

threatModel.threat: Unapproved publish via tag push or bypassing npm job via --targets
threatModel.mitigation: Attach environment: release to every publish job (npm, github-packages, github-release, homebrew) and require GitHub Environment Required Reviewers + tag rulesets.

threatModel.threat: Shell expression injection or unverified artifact tampering between verify and publish jobs
threatModel.mitigation: Pass job outputs through env: variables (never inline ${{ ... }} in run:) and verify sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS.txt before publishing.

threatModel.threat: Silent overwrite of existing repository customizations or path traversal via crafted bin name
threatModel.mitigation: Three-way hash conflict detection against .packnpub/state.json, unified diff preview, hard-stop on conflicts, and strict root path confinement.
threatModel.verification: Conflicting & invalid fixture suite + path-traversal unit tests

threatModel.threat: Static secret leakage via long-lived NPM_TOKEN or direct push to homebrew-tap main
threatModel.mitigation: Use OIDC Trusted Publishing with SLSA provenance for npm, persist-credentials: false on read-only checkouts, and PR-based Homebrew tap updates.
threatModel.verification: Workflow static policy checks + security review

compatibility.breakingChangePolicy: Contract major increments require documented migration path, dry-run diff preview, conflict hard-stop, and atomic rollback.
